title: cloud: the builder authors a computed value meant to be totalled as a field of its return type with an `expression`, not a formula, and the analytics tools follow the new remedy (#32443, cloud#3567)

Dedupe (open AND closed): `apply_blueprint formula` → 13 hits, `builder formula aggregate` → 80, `3567 formula` → 11; none asks for this. #31155 (closed) ported cloud's authoring rules into `@objectstack/skills` in general; #32532 (open, `domain:skills`) fixes the published skills' text for this case. objectstack-ai/cloud was not searched from this session (outside its repository scope).
Blocked-by: #32545
Blocked-by: #32614

## Business reason

cloud#3567 (group C, B9): asked for a monthly operating report (「月度经营分析」), the builder authored 销售额 = 销量 × 单价 as a `formula` field. `aggregate_data` and `visualize_data` then refused every sum over it (4 of 4: `[dataset-compiler] ... declares as formula`). The error's remedy at the time was a number field kept up to date by a hook, which the in-app builder cannot author. The agent gave the right numbers but no chart.

#32443 rules that a computed value is made totallable by declaring it as a field of its return type carrying the same `expression`: computed by the engine on every write and kept in a column, so `sum` / `avg` work. PR #32545 rewrites the refusal's remedy to say exactly that. Until the builder authors this shape and the analytics tools act on the new remedy, every report that totals a computed amount (sales, cost, days) keeps failing the same way on hosted apps.

## Ask

1. **Builder authoring rule.** When the requirement totals, averages or charts a computed value (amount = quantity × unit price, days = end − start + 1), author it as a field of the value's return type (`number`, `currency`, `percent`, `date`, …) with the same `expression`, not as `type: 'formula'`. Keep `formula` for values that are only displayed (a composed title, a label). Name the return type, not "number field": a date expression on a number field is refused at every write.
2. **Analytics tools.** When `aggregate_data` / `visualize_data` meet the refusal of a total over a formula, the agent follows the remedy PR #32545 writes: hand the change to the builder (a field of the return type with the same `expression`), not a hook and not a manual workaround. Check the tool's own guidance and any cloud-side text that still names the hook remedy.
3. **Pin cloud#3567 B9** as a regression: the monthly report over 销售额 builds, sums and charts.

## Dependencies and known limits

- **The blueprint contract.** `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts` describes the strict field's `expression` as "REQUIRED when type is "formula" … null for every other field type" (the strict `StrictField`, which the design model reads), and the lenient `BlueprintFieldSchema.expression` mentions only `formula`. As written, the design model is told to leave `expression` null on a number field. That describe is objectstack's (`domain:spec`): #32614. The authoring rule holds only once it lands in cloud's pin. Measure whether `apply_blueprint` carries `expression` onto a non-formula field, and post the reading on #32614.
- **Existing apps.** Turning an existing formula into a stored field on an app that has rows leaves those rows `NULL` until #32527 (the platform fills at save or publish) is live; the one-time hosted sweep is #32596. New apps are not affected.
- **Pin probe** for the remedy wording: `git merge-base --is-ancestor <#32545's squash sha on main> <sha in cloud's .objectstack-sha>`, run in an objectstack checkout.
- Hosted tiers: a field `expression` is allowed at every tier (`judgeRestrictionProfile` does not read fields; read from code on #32443, not measured on a live tenant).

## Acceptance notes

- The B9 case passes in cloud's eval or golden-journey suite: the built field is not `type: 'formula'`, carries the expression, and the dataset `sum` over it is right.
- No builder rule or analytics guidance text names a hook as the way to total a computed value.

Related: #32443, PR #32545, #32527, #32596, #32614 (blueprint describe), #32532 (published skills), #31155 (one authoring source, cloud#3659 A), objectstack-ai/cloud#3567.
